reason: Driven and measured at 1440: Tasks .carry kbd is Geist Mono 10px/400, +0.004em, line-height normal, radius 5px, pad 3px 5px, 19px tall; Notes .act/.dockField kbd is Geist SANS 11px/600, radius 4px, pad 1px 5px, 17.9px tall; Timeline .b-undo kbd is Geist Mono 11px/400, +0.04em, radius 0, pad 0 - no box at all. Notes' `font: inherit` gives it not two but THREE letterfits on one object (-0.0142em in .act/.dockField, -0.0164em in .darkAct at notes.voice, -0.0071em in .undoAct after a seam send), all tighter than Notes' own declared 11px tracking (--tr-11: 0em) and tighter than its 15px body at --tr-14 (-0.012em), so the curve inverts at the smallest size. A font-size census of every visible text node across all nine gated states at 1920 returns 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 20, 27, 30, 96 and 148 and no 10, and no kbd is visible in tasks.board or tasks.dense at rest - so the 10px cap is a ramp step that exists only in ungated states neither gate can see, and this is exactly the residue tools/exclusions.mjs hands to the panel rather than proves.
sharpenedFix: Consolidate as proposed - 11px mono at +0.04em, the one spec that sits on an existing ramp step and does not fight the curve - but scope and finish it properly. (1) Scope the shared rule to the app (`#deck kbd` or `.app kbd`), not bare `kbd` at :root, so it cannot reach chrome outside the three products. (2) Unify the RING mechanism too, not just colour: Tasks uses `border: 1px solid` while Notes uses `box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px`, which is why the two caps measure 19px and 17.9px tall even before the size change - declare the inset ring once and leave each product only its ring colour and fill. (3) The three Notes letterfits are all inherited: replace `font: inherit` with an explicit `letter-spacing: var(--cap-track)` at all five sites (notes.css 513, 542, 867, 908, 1032) rather than relying on the shared rule to win. (4) Re-measure the arrows exception (tasks.css:1578) after the 10 to 11px change before choosing 0.18em, and re-check .undoAct, which currently has no box and will gain one.
